title: Temporal Adjustments in the Evaluation of Events: The "Rosy View"

publication.publisher_or_container: Journal of Experimental Social Psychology, Vol. 33, No. 4

verification.verification_notes: Citation (journal, volume, issue, pages, year, DOI) and abstract-level findings - across three event studies (European trip, Thanksgiving vacation, California bicycle trip) expectations were more positive than in-event experience and later recollection more positive than the experience, with negative in-event thoughts fading within days - verified via Elsevier/ScienceDirect and indexing records on web search 2026-09-24.
